name: – Leire Pajín, Aurelijus Veryga – Article 5, § 1, point b – Am 346
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: (b) facilitate participation in joint training and exercises. This Regulation shall not confer any power on the Commission or the High Representative to set binding national civil-military preparedness priorities or to task, deploy or command national military assets.
